description: 2034 is the Year of the Wood Tiger in the Chinese zodiac, from February 19, 2034 to February 7, 2035. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 2034 is the Year of the Wood Tiger, a Yang year. It began at Lunar New Year on February 19, 2034 and ended on February 7, 2035, so people born in 2034 before Feb 19 belong to the Water Ox year.

sections.heading: 2034 Lunar New Year: start and end dates
paragraphs: Lunar New Year opened the Wood Tiger year on February 19, 2034, and the year ran to February 7, 2035. So a birth date of Feb 19, 2034 or later counts as Wood Tiger, and so do early 2035 birthdays through Feb 7; births in 2034 before Feb 19 still belong to the Water Ox. That moving boundary comes from the lunisolar calendar, in which the new year starts with the second new moon after the winter solstice in most years, so its Gregorian date shifts by up to a month from one year to the next. Look sixty years either side and the pairing repeats: 1974 are Wood Tiger years too. That Sunday new year arrived with the Sun in Pisces in the Western zodiac.

sections.heading: What the Wood Tiger is like
paragraphs: Double Wood makes this Tiger year famous for sociable idealism. Those born now are pictured as cooperative, bold and willing to share the spotlight. They inspire others readily. Partnering with patient finishers, checking commitments before relying on them and outdoor activity to settle their energy are the classic suggestions. Their generosity tends to make rivals into friends, and their hope can lift an entire group's spirits.

In the five-element scheme, Wood belongs to the east and to the green energy of early spring, and that seasonal image shapes how it colours an animal sign. A Wood stem tends to soften sharp edges and add warmth, curiosity and a cooperative instinct. Traditional texts associate it with benevolence, growth and the wish to build something that lasts beyond the self. People born under a Wood stem are often portrayed as principled, open-handed and hopeful about others. The caution usually attached to Wood is a habit of spreading energy thinly, saying yes to every request and feeling quietly hurt when generosity is not returned in kind.

sections.heading: 2034 in the animal cycle and in numerology
paragraphs: In numerology the year reduces to 9, the number of completion, generosity and letting go, and a 9 year is traditionally read as one of endings that clear space. The digits of 2034 add up to 9. The Tiger holds the third place among the twelve animals and its fixed element is Wood. Set beside the year's Wood stem, wood year element matches the fixed element, which readings use to describe how settled or stretched the combination feels. The year before was the Water Ox and the year after is the Wood Rabbit.

Chinese almanacs name 2034 Jia-Yin, pairing the Wood stem Jia with the branch Yin. Both are Yang, as stem and branch always share a polarity, so of the hundred and twenty possible pairings only sixty ever occur, and each one names a single year in every cycle.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 2034?
faq.answer: 2034 is the Year of the Wood Tiger. It started on February 19, 2034 and ended on February 7, 2035.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 2034?
faq.answer: Check the date against Feb 19. Born before February 19, 2034, you are a Water Ox; born on or after it, you are a Wood Tiger.

faq.question: What element is 2034 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Wood, a Yang year. The Tiger's own fixed element is Wood; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 2034?
faq.answer: Jia-Yin. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Wood Tiger year?
faq.answer: 2094, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 1974.
